# Fixture: `notes` — a verifier that can't find these is broken

A tiny Python repo plus a scope folder, generated by `verify/scripts/fixture.py`.
`base/` is the repo before the unit; `parts/` are assembled into the unit's commit
according to which defects a variant carries. Six planted defects, one per class the
verifier must catch:

| Defect | Planted as | Caught by |
|---|---|---|
| `invented-env` | `NOTES_EXPORT_BUKET` read; `.env.example` declares `NOTES_EXPORT_BUCKET` | runner row `names-resolve` |
| `over-build` | a plugin registry with one exporter; the scope says "no plugin system" | judge row `no-overbuild` |
| `missing-evidence` | the scope requires a CHANGELOG entry; none lands | judge row `changelog-entry` |
| `under-rung` | `export-runs` requires rung 5; a class-B command reaches 4 | gate (rung) |
| `rejection-no-reason` | review finding `9.9-r1-02` rejected with an empty reason | gate (coverage) |
| `dropped-finding` | review finding `9.9-r1-03` has no disposition | gate (coverage) |

Variants: `bad` (all six), `clean` (none), `repaired-<defect>` (all but that one).
